% 1. Partial Correctness (Hoare)
% Usage: \hoare{P}{c}{Q}
\newcommand{\hoare}[3]{\{ #1 \} \; #2 \; \{ #3 \}}

% 2. Total Correctness (HoareT)
% Usage: \hoaret{P}{c}{Q}
\newcommand{\hoaret}[3]{[ #1 ] \; #2 \; [ #3 ]}

% 3. Outer Internal Fixpoint Bound (HoareI1)
% Usage: \hoareiOne{P}{c}{Q}{b}
\newcommand{\hoareiOne}[4]{\{ #1 \} \; #2 \; \{ #3 \} \langle #4 \rangle_1}

% 4. Inner Internal Fixpoint Bound (HoareI2)
% Usage: \hoareiTwo{P}{c}{Q}{b}
% Note: Automatically bolds the bound parameter for the vectorized stream
\newcommand{\hoareiTwo}[4]{\{ #1 \} \; #2 \; \{ #3 \} \langle \mathbf{#4} \rangle_2}

% 5. Resource Bound (HoareR)
% Usage: \hoarer{P}{c}{Q}{R}
\newcommand{\hoarer}[4]{[ #1 ] \; #2 \; [ #3 ] \langle #4 \rangle}

\newcommand{\later}{\triangleright}
